packet.question: Assess the supplied monthly access-review requirement for hosted systems.

criteria.control_fit: The control addresses all privileged accounts, approved-owner review and monthly deadline within each population.
criteria.implementation: Applicable configuration/test evidence establishes that the described control is enabled, owned and covers the population.
criteria.execution: Applicable November records establish review by approved owners of all accounts and recorded decisions by November 30. Late receipt alone is not late execution.

limitations: Synthetic source assertions; authenticity and population completeness are assumed for this exercise.
No broader operational effectiveness or regulatory compliance conclusion.

sources.text: Approved owners must review all privileged accounts on hosted production servers monthly, by month end.
Control K7 requires approved owners to review all privileged accounts monthly for its stated population and record decisions by month end.
Configuration test for K7 on November 30 confirms the review process is enabled, assigned to approved owners and includes all privileged accounts in the stated population.
K7 report export for November: no review completion or decision-recording details are included in this export.
